title: Sampling switch
description: An NMOS sampling switch sized by its on-resistance. The device is bound width-first at a small drain-source voltage vds_test (deep triode), with W_sw the geometry knob and gm_id_on the inversion knob. In the on state the gate sits at VDD and the source near ground, so the switch runs at $V_{GS}$ = VDD; gm_id_on is retuned until the reported $V_{GS}$ equals that gate drive, checked by the gate-drive-consistent guardrail. From the sized device the sheet reports the on-resistance $R_{on}$ = vds_test/id, the RC sampling bandwidth into the sample capacitor $C_s$, the sampled $kT/C$ noise, and a worst-case charge-injection voltage step. The charge-injection figure is estimate-grade: it assumes half the inversion charge dumps onto $C_s$, which depends on switching speed and source impedance a lookup table cannot capture.

params.name: VDD
params.note: gate drive in the on state

params.name: W_sw
params.note: switch width: wider lowers Ron but raises cgg (more charge injection and clock feedthrough)

params.name: gm_id_on
params.note: on-state inversion knob; retune until the reported vgs equals VDD (gate-drive-consistent guardrail)

params.name: vds_test
params.note: small drain-source probe voltage for the triode on-resistance

params.name: L
params.note: minimum L for the lowest Ron and least channel charge

rows.name: Ron
rows.note: triode on-resistance, the small-signal probe voltage over the drain current

rows.name: BW
rows.note: single-pole RC sampling bandwidth into C_s

rows.name: vn_kTC
rows.note: sampled kT/C noise, RMS; set by C_s alone, independent of the switch

rows.name: q_inj
rows.note: estimate: half the inversion channel charge cgg*(vgs - vth) dumped by the switch

rows.name: dv_inj
rows.note: estimate: the sampled voltage step from that charge; true value depends on switching speed and source impedance

rules.note: gm/ID cannot exceed the weak-inversion ceiling of the data
the RC settling bandwidth must clear the sampling rate
sampled kT/C noise must meet the budget (raise C_s to lower it)
the on-state runs at vgs = VDD; retune gm_id_on until the reported vgs matches the gate drive
estimate-grade charge-injection step; a narrower switch or dummy/bottom-plate sampling reduces it
